ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a square coil, with point A marked at the upper-left vertex of the square. The current arrows show: the current on the top side is to the right, the current on the right side is downward, the current on the bottom side is to the left, and the current on the left side is upward, so the current flows clockwise along the square. Reasoning: Use the formula for the magnetic flux density produced by a finite-length straight wire at a point, B = μ0 I/(4πa)(sinθ1 + sinθ2). For the top and left wires connected to A, with respect to A the current element dl and the position vector r pointing to A are collinear, so dl × r = 0, and the contribution is zero. The perpendicular distance from the right vertical side to A is l, and as seen from A the angles corresponding to the two ends of this side are 0° and 45°, so the contribution is μ0 I/(4πl) sin45°. The perpendicular distance from the lower horizontal side to A is also l, and as seen from A the angles corresponding to the two ends of this side are likewise 0° and 45°, so the contribution is also μ0 I/(4πl) sin45°. According to the right-hand rule, the directions of the magnetic fields of these two parts are the same, so they are added: B = 2 × μ0 I/(4πl) × 1/√2 = √2 μ0 I/(4πl).

method.method_draft: First describe the image geometry: A is the upper-left vertex of the square, the arrows show clockwise current around the square. Apply the finite straight wire formula to each side. The two sides meeting at A contribute zero because for points on their line dl is parallel to r. The right vertical side and the bottom horizontal side each have perpendicular distance l from A and are seen from A between angles 0° and 45°, so each contributes mu0 I/(4 pi l) sin45°. Their directions are the same by the right-hand rule, so add them: B = 2 * mu0 I/(4 pi l) * 1/sqrt2 = sqrt2 mu0 I/(4 pi l).

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一匝方形导线线圈，点 A 位于方形的左上角黑点处。电流方向如箭头所示：上边向右、右边向下、下边向左、左边向上，整体为顺时针方向。要求求点 A 处的磁感应强度 B。

推理：按指定方法取坐标系，令 A=(0,0)，x 轴向右，y 轴向上，因此方形线圈位于 A 的右下方，边长为 l。

上边导线位于 y=0，从 A 向右；左边导线位于 x=0，从下向上到 A。对于这两条边上的任意电流元，指向 A 的位矢 r 都与电流元 dl 平行或反平行，所以 Biot-Savart 定律中的 dl × r = 0，因此上边和左边对 A 点的磁场贡献为 0。

右边导线参数化为 (l,y)，其中 y 从 0 到 -l，dl = dy yhat。到 A 的距离为 sqrt(l^2+y^2)，且 dl 与 r 的垂直臂为 l，所以磁场大小微元为 |dB| = (μ0 I)/(4π) · l |dy|/(l^2+y^2)^(3/2)。令正积分变量从 0 到 l，得 B_right = (μ0 I)/(4π) ∫_0^l l dy/(l^2+y^2)^(3/2) = (μ0 I)/(4π) · 1/(l√2) = μ0 I/(4π l√2)。

底边导线参数化为 (x,-l)，其中 x 从 l 到 0，dl = dx xhat。与右边完全类似，垂直臂也是 l，因此 B_bottom = μ0 I/(4π l√2)。

由右手定则，右边和底边在 A 点产生的磁场方向相同；对图中的顺时针电流，它们都指向纸内。因此总磁场大小为 B = B_right + B_bottom = 2 · μ0 I/(4π l√2) = √2 μ0 I/(4π l)。
